What is the stated origin of the name 'P.answer: The name derives from the biblical root פ.ל.ש (P.L.SH), later used in 'Syria-Palaestina', a name given by the Roman Empire to the province of Judea after suppressing the Bar Kokhba revolt, in order to sever the connection between the Jews and their land.
